study_title: UBP Geometric Virology: A Computational Immunology Study
subtitle: Applying the Universal Binary Principal to Viral Protein Interaction Modeling
author: Manus AI for Euan Craig (UBP Research, New Zealand)

interventions.name: Dexamethasone (corticosteroid)
interventions.mechanism: Broad anti-inflammatory; reduces IL-6, TNF, CRP
interventions.clinical_evidence: 28% mortality reduction in severe COVID-19 (RECOVERY trial)

interventions.name: Baricitinib (JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor)
interventions.mechanism: Blocks JAK-STAT signaling downstream of cytokine receptors
interventions.clinical_evidence: 38% mortality reduction in severe COVID-19 (COV-BARRIER trial)

neutralization.interpretation: Antibody does not raise energy — incomplete neutralization

omicron_entry.interpretation: Energetically favorable binding — consistent with spontaneous viral entry

viral_assembly.description: Viral Assembly: Spike + Membrane + Envelope + Nucleocapsid
